item.title: Durant scores 35 points as Rockets hold on to beat Hornets 105-101
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. item.title: Traffic on Hwy 17 due to accident in Bertie County
item.description: BERTIE COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- The Bertie County Sheriff's Office said there is a reported accident on Highway 17 near Grandy Lane. Officials said that first responders are on the scene and traffic is delayed. More information will be released as details become apparent.
